coDriverCoach_toggle.title: Co-Driver Coach: on / off
coDriverCoach_toggle.desc: Turn the co-driver coach on or off

coDriverCoach_voice.title: Co-Driver Coach: voice on / off
coDriverCoach_voice.desc: Mute or unmute the co-driver voice

coDriverCoach_surface.title: Co-Driver Coach: surface
coDriverCoach_surface.desc: Cycle tarmac / gravel / snow grip for braking cues

coDriverCoach_endDrive.title: Co-Driver Coach: end drive
coDriverCoach_endDrive.desc: Finish the current drive and show the drive summary

coDriverCoach_menu.title: Co-Driver Coach: scenarios menu
coDriverCoach_menu.desc: Open or close the practice scenarios menu

coDriverCoach_restart.title: Co-Driver Coach: restart scenario
coDriverCoach_restart.desc: Load the last scenario again with the same car and stage options

coDriverCoach_talk.title: Co-Driver Coach: talk to engineer (hold)
coDriverCoach_talk.desc: Hold, ask your race engineer a question (brakes, tyres, engine, fuel, weather, or about the analysis), release to send

coDriverCoach_armReplay.onDown: if coDriverAnalysis and coDriverAnalysis.armReplay(true) then guihooks.message('Replay recording on for this drive', 3, 'coDriverAnalysis') end
coDriverCoach_armReplay.title: Co-Driver Coach: record replay for this drive
coDriverCoach_armReplay.desc: In 'laps / stages only' mode, also record the replay of the drive in progress

coDriverCoach_lapStart.title: Co-Driver Coach: lap timing start here
coDriverCoach_lapStart.desc: Mark a start line where the car is. Mark a finish later, or come back to it for a loop

coDriverCoach_lapFinish.title: Co-Driver Coach: lap timing finish here
coDriverCoach_lapFinish.desc: Mark the finish line where the car is: saves a point-to-point route from the start mark

coDriverCoach_settings.onDown: if coDriverAnalysis then if coDriverAnalysis.isOpen() then coDriverAnalysis.close() else coDriverAnalysis.openSettings() end end
coDriverCoach_settings.title: Co-Driver Coach: settings
coDriverCoach_settings.desc: Open or close the settings (calls, voice, braking aid, laps, recording, engineer)

coDriverCoach_status.onDown: if coDriverEngineer then coDriverEngineer.ask('Status report.', 'drive') end
coDriverCoach_status.title: Co-Driver Coach: car status report
coDriverCoach_status.desc: The race engineer reports brakes, tyres, engine, fuel and damage
